objective: Deterministically select and hash-lock genuinely fresh UCI classification datasets using official metadata only, after excluding every repository-contaminated dataset.
protocol: Fetch official UCI Python-available metadata; exclude every frozen UCI ID and contaminated dataset-name token; filter only by preregistered metadata criteria; rank by SHA-256 of the frozen seed, ID, name and canonical metadata digest; download ranked standardized CSV bytes only to hash and size them; never parse records or labels.
next_stage: Commit the resulting immutable manifest, then run the frozen v0.72 compiler, selector and planners unchanged on a separate blind-execution branch.
claim_boundary: Hash-lock provenance only. No dataset record or label is parsed and no solver is executed. This stage is not external algorithmic evidence, novelty, publication, acceptance, or a world-level claim.
